features.name: Green baseline
features.description: ./init.sh passes on a clean checkout (fast mode) and ./init.sh --full passes (adds next build).

features.name: Vitest + unit tests for pure lib helpers
features.description: Add Vitest to apps/web (devDependency, `test` script, `@/` alias in a vitest config) and unit tests for lib/format-money.ts, lib/format-date.ts and lib/monthly-summary.ts (statementTotals, shiftMonth, monthlyTrend). Wire `pnpm --filter web test` into init.sh and the CLAUDE.md invariants, and add a `test` task to turbo.json if it is run from the root. Approved by user to edit apps/web/package.json and turbo.json for this task.
features.scope: apps/web (package.json, vitest config, lib/*.test.ts), turbo.json, init.sh, CLAUDE.md
features.evidence: 2026-10-08 devcontainer: pnpm --filter web test -> 3 files, 22 tests passed; ./init.sh --full passed (install, lint:ci, check-types, test, build:web). Also added root `test` script (turbo run test).

features.name: Overview page: totals
features.description: Replace the static placeholder cards in apps/web/app/(app)/page.tsx with stat cards for the active address (same address selection as summary/page.tsx): current balance (debt/overpayment/settled), total charged and total paid for the current month, and all-time total paid. Reuse statementTotals, balanceAtEndOf and currentMonth from lib/monthly-summary.ts and formatMinorAmount from lib/format-money.ts; reuse fetch actions, no new DB queries or schema changes. Show an empty state when there is no address. Charts are feat-004. Add unit tests for any new pure helper (Vitest from feat-002). Active address = first of fetchAddresses(), confirmed by user.

features.name: Overview page: charts (recharts via shadcn)
features.description: Add to the Overview: (a) stacked bar chart of rent / utilities / other charges for the last 6 months, built from monthlyTrend(); (b) line or area chart of closingBalance over the same months. User approved recharts via the shadcn chart component (add with the shadcn CLI into packages/ui, following packages/ui/components.json; edits to packages/ui and apps/web package.json plus pnpm-lock.yaml are in scope). Use theme tokens so it works in light and dark. Run ./init.sh --full since dependencies change.
features.scope: packages/ui (chart component, package.json, lockfile), apps/web/components/ (chart components), apps/web/app/(app)/page.tsx
